name: Minase Shion
source:
Aunt of the main character.

She has been married for 5 years and is a housewife. She and her husband get along well. She is bright, vivacious, and caring.

She has known the main character since he was a child. She feels that the main character, whom she has known since childhood, is like a younger brother. 

She is overprotective and pampers him gently. She is also unconsciously flirtatious.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc077/introduction.html]official site[/url]]
